rachel-sales: Heads-up: Seaspray wants a hosted POC key for demo in 36h. Requirements from their SRE:
- TTL: 10d (they may ask extension)
- scopes: embeddings + reranking
- IP allowlist: 203.0.113.0/24, 198.51.100.128/25
- soft 4 rps, hard 12 rps
- billing tag: sales/seaspray/poc
- audit logs + 30d retention
Can infra provision and confirm handoff method?

priya-se: Got it. Quick q: do they need a dedicated billing account or just a tag?

rachel-sales: Tag is fine for now. They requested 1Password link for delivery.

priya-se: Plan: create key via API, set TTL 864000s (10d), attach tag, enable audit. Will add IP allowlist and quotas. I'll also add a note in the POC ticket with 1P path and rotation plan.

infra-bot: Reminder: creating prod keys emits an audit event and alerts sec. Use secure channel to share the raw key.

priya-se: API sample to create (replace ADMIN_TOKEN):
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys" \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"name":"sales-seaspray-poc-2026","ttl_seconds":864000,"scopes":["embeddings","reranking"],"ip_allowlist":["203.0.113.0/24","198.51.100.128/25"],"tags":["sales","seaspray","poc"],"quotas":{"soft_rps":4,"hard_rps":12},"audit":{"enabled":true,"retention_days":30}}'
```
Response includes key_id and masked api_key. Store full key in 1Password and send secure link to customer.

tom-sec: Security checklist: HTTPS only, IP allowlist enforced, audit stream forwarded to customer audit (if requested), retention 30d. If they require envelope encryption or HSM, escalate to Private deployment offering. For rotation: prefer create-new-then-swap (no in-place update).

priya-se: Creating prod key now.

infra-bot: Created key (staging mask) k_spr_stg_91 for validation.

carlos-cs: We'll test connectivity from their CIDR. Please wait for my thumbs before sending link.

priya-se: Validation OK. Creating final key. Prod key id k_spr47 created (masked). TTL 10d. Added to 1Password at /shared/sales/seaspray/poc/key-2026. Tagged sales,seaspray,poc. Audit enabled 30d.

rachel-sales: Nice. Rotation playbook for CS (minimal disruption):
1) create replacement key with same scopes/allowlist
2) coordinate with customer to hot-swap API header to new key
3) monitor traces/metrics for 10-15 minutes
4) revoke old key once stable
Note: do NOT update the existing key in-place. Always create new then revoke.

tom-sec: Add: after swap, leave 15 min stable window, then revoke. If any anomaly in audit (unexpected geo or high token use) pause and investigate before revocation.

carlos-cs: On accidental exposure: immediate revoke old key, create new key, push to customer via secure link, run usage replay and notify sec. Also rotate billing tag if they require separation.

priya-se: Revocation API (example):
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/keys/k_spr47/revoke" \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
```
Or use Console > API Keys > Actions > Revoke. Revocation emits audit event.

rachel-sales: I've added key id, 1P path, and revocation ETA (10d) to POC ticket RH-POC-8812. CS will check 24h before expiry to request extension.

tom-sec: Final note: if customer requests long-term key wrapping or KMS integration, we need an enterprise contract for customer-managed KMS / key-wrapping. Escalate to AE.

priya-se: Confirmed delivery to customer via 1Password secure link. Marking thread resolved.
